summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching subscription agreements with Canada Growth Fund Inc., Investissement Québec, and ENI International B.V., dated April 9, 2026, for the issuance of 44,452,460 purchased shares at a total subscription price of CAD 81,792,526.40 (approx. CAD 1.84/share). The proceeds fund the Matawinie Project design, engineering, and construction, plus general expenses. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural mechanics (e.g., overhang, collateral) are stated. This is a capital-raising private placement under Canadian law, not a tender offer, going-private, or other special situation. Watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions.
